cases.headline: Anthropic to commit up to 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund, with potential for more as company grows
cases.body: Anthropic will allocate 5% of its shares to a newly created Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval, with an additional 2% to be added for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline at the board's discretion. The fund, structured as a wholly-owned LLC, is intended to support projects for societal good, including large donations to nonprofits or direct distributions. None of the equity will be used for lobbying or political giving. Combined with prior commitments from founders and employees, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to public benefit, with the possibility of further increases tied to company growth. Details on the fund's governance and structure will be released in the coming months.
cases.labelReason: Approval conditions a fixed 5% allocation; it does not establish a discretionary range.

evidence.quote: Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline.

cases.headline: Anthropic to commit 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund, with potential for more as company grows
cases.body: Anthropic announced the creation of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly-owned LLC that will receive 5% of the company's shares, subject to stockholder approval. The fund's stake may increase by 2% for every 50% rise in Anthropic's value above a set baseline, at the board's discretion. The fund is intended to support projects for societal good, including large donations or direct distributions, and will not be used for lobbying or political giving. Combined with prior commitments, about 20% of Anthropic shares are now dedicated to public benefit, with further increases possible if valuation milestones are met. Details on the fund's structure and governance will be shared in the coming months.
cases.labelReason: Future combined commitments are not established as completed now.

evidence.quote: This builds on commitments our co-founders and employees have already made. When Anthropic was founded, our co-founders pledged to donate 80% of their equity holdings, and since founding we have also operated an equity donation match program that allows employees to pledge equity which Anthropic matches. Approximately half of our employees participate in this program. When combined with today’s announcement, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good, plus any additional percentage that could be added if the company reaches specific valuation milestones.
